rationale: Per-sample GEO files combined into counts.tsv by prepare.R; gene id is the gRNA id with trailing _<n> stripped (identical to the Un2_gRNA sheet). Columns: Lib = plasmid input, P4 = in vitro passage 4, WT_01..WT_09 = parasites recovered from nine infected mouse spleens at day 7. Primary analysis reproduces the paper's in vivo test (Wilcoxon of guide log2 fold changes, WT mice vs P4): nine mice against the single P4 reference, ~ condition, 8 residual df, so the standard BARCS model applies and between-mouse variation sets the dispersion. Secondary: P4 vs plasmid (in vitro fitness), one library each, zero residual df, so rho is pooled across all guides. The library has no non-targeting guides; its controls are in vitro essential/dispensable and the in vivo virulence genes ROP18 and GRA23, none a null, so control_gene_pattern is unset and calibration cannot be checked. In vivo libraries are bottlenecked, so library totals shift almost every gene to depletion; the primary analysis uses median-ratio totals and the library-total fit is a sensitivity analysis.
